observations.code_quote: Each run also copies the logs alert's snooze onto its platform alert row, so a snoozed alert stays silent, and an alert unsnoozed since the last run is unsnoozed here too.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that snooze state is propagated from Logs alerts to Platform alerts during backfill, preserving the silent state.
